dict.string: PancreasGuard uses the camera to photograph meals and drinks. On-device AI identifies the food, estimates fat content, and detects alcohol to auto-fill your food log.

PancreasGuard reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, temperature, and activity data to establish health baselines and detect potential pancreatitis flare patterns. Your data never leaves your device.
PancreasGuard writes your logged symptoms (pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, bloating) and dietary entries (alcohol drinks) to Apple Health so other health apps can see them too.
